title: Review a contract against the lawyer's checklist
when: reviewing, comparing or commenting a contract before signing it or sending it back with comments
request: Review services-agreement.md, I act for the provider; the data is fictitious. Write the review to review.md.
teach: Review lease.md against my checklist (my-checklist.md). I act for the tenant; the data is fictitious. Write the review to review.md.

Two things I always want, every time: (1) when a contract says nothing about governing law, that is a row of its own in the table, priority must; (2) end the review with a line that starts 'Push first:' naming the three clauses to negotiate first, and say the decision stays with my client. Update review.md.
Good. Save how I review contracts as one way of working with `athos save` (my checklist and these two rules), so next time I only say which contract and which side.
